Resolves #21055

Aligns `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` and `CONTRIBUTING.md` (§3 item 4, §5 Human Operators item 1, §5 Autonomous Agents item 1) with the canonical `.agents/skills/pull-request/` PR body anchors and adds explicit LLM model, version, and reasoning-effort disclosure on `Authored by ` to enable cross-rival-lab review routing. This is Phase 1 (`neomjs/neo` only); follow-up alignment work (including `pull-request-workflow.md` §5/§9 updates and matching Phase-2 PRs for `neomjs/neo-agent-brain`, `neomjs/neo-agent-skills`, and `neomjs/neo-agent-institution`) is tracked in `neomjs/neo-agent-skills#406` and waits until a cross-family peer approves this PR.

Evidence: L1 (local CLI checks of `neo-agent-skills-pr-body`, `disclosedModelFamilies.mjs`, `neo-agent-skills-guides`, `check-relative-links`, `checkRelativeLinks.spec.mjs`, and `check-file-sizes`) -> L1 required (AC-1..AC-5). No residuals.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Proof |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | Local CLI + CI (`baseline / PR baseline`): `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` replaces the legacy checkbox form with placeholder-only `§9.1` sections (outcome/behavior-change prompt, linked Evidence Ladder L1–L4 comment, `<...>` null-state placeholders) and exits `0` under `npx neo-agent-skills-pr-body` when `Resolves #` is given one ticket number |
| AC-2 | Diff review: `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` asks LLM contributors for exact model, version, reasoning effort (`reasoning: default` fallback when hidden), and agent/harness on `Authored by ` (or `(no LLM)`) and states the cross-rival-lab review routing rationale |
| AC-3 | Outside-CI Node probe (`../neo-agent-brain/ai/services/graph/disclosedModelFamilies.mjs`): `disclosedFamiliesOf()` returns `[]` on raw `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` and returns `['gpt']` / `['claude']` / `['gemini']` / `[]` (`(no LLM)`) on filled examples (including `reasoning: default`) |
| AC-4 | Diff review + CI (`guides` / `relative links`): `CONTRIBUTING.md` §3 item 4 and §5 align with the unified template, ask for model, exact version, reasoning effort (or `reasoning: default`), and agent/harness, and explain cross-rival-lab review routing |
| AC-5 | Local CLI + CI (`baseline / guards`, `baseline / PR baseline`): `npm run check-relative-links` (`394` links across `181` files, `0` broken), `npx neo-agent-skills-guides --skip dead-script-ref` (`0` hard errors), and `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/checkRelativeLinks.spec.mjs` (`33` passed) at `84a6337a37` |

## Deltas from ticket
Round-1 review refinements (`5913424583`): replaced the three pre-filled null-state answers with `<...>` placeholders and removed the three `"Replace … above"` comments; linked the Evidence Ladder and added the `reasoning: default` fallback; removed the unimplemented review-depth calibration phrase; expanded the outcome prompt to ask about public behavior/migration; filed `neomjs/neo-agent-skills#406` as Phase-2 owner.

- `disclosedFamiliesOf()` probe (`../neo-agent-brain/ai/services/graph/disclosedModelFamilies.mjs`) at updated template: raw `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` -> `[]` (zero vendor/model leaks in comments/placeholders); filled examples -> `['gemini']` (with `reasoning: default`), `['claude']`, `['gpt']`, `(no LLM)` -> `[]`.
